summary: Recent updates in the Media IPC (Inter-Process Communication) area of Firefox have introduced enhancements to support hardware acceleration for video decoding. This means that instead of relying solely on software, the browser can leverage your computer's GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) to decode video more efficiently. By adding plumbing for this hardware support to the RemoteDecoderModule, Firefox can enable smoother playback and potentially lower energy consumption during media playback. **This optimization is crucial for improving video performance in high-definition formats** like HEVC, making streaming and viewing experiences better for users.
